extracted.intended_audience: federal agency heads and staff responsible for implementing EO 13175 tribal consultation requirements; OMB/DPC reviewers; tribal affairs coordinators
extracted.subtask_description: Prepare and submit an agency-specific Tribal Consultation Plan and required progress reports to OMB to implement the policies and directives of Executive Order 13175, and designate an official to coordinate implementation and reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission of a detailed plan of actions to OMB
rubrics_metrics.description: Each agency head submit to OMB a detailed plan of actions the agency will take to implement the policies and directives of EO 13175.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Presidential Memorandum (Nov 5, 2009) requires agencies to produce such a plan; OSTP provides its own Tribal Consultation Plan as an example. The plan should be sufficiently detailed to show how the agency will implement EO 13175's consultation and coordination requirements with Indian tribal governments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission of a progress report with proposed updates
rubrics_metrics.description: Agencies must submit to OMB a progress report on the actions taken pursuant to these plans together with proposed updates to the plan.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Progress reports should document actions taken to implement the plan and propose any updates or changes to the plan based on implementation experience. OSTP has submitted its Progress Report as the agency example.

rubrics_metrics.name: Designation of an appropriate official to coordinate implementation and reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: Each agency's plan and subsequent reports shall designate an appropriate official to coordinate implementation of the plan and preparation of the required progress reports.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The designated official serves as the agency point of contact for tribal consultation implementation and reporting. OSTP designates its General Counsel as the point of contact (phone and email provided on the page).

rubrics_metrics.name: OMB and DPC review for consistency with EO 13175
rubrics_metrics.description: OMB and the White House Domestic Policy Council (DPC) will review these plans for consistency with EO 13175.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Plans submitted by agencies will be reviewed by OMB and DPC to ensure they align with the policies and directives of EO 13175; this review informs any cross-agency assessment and recommendations.

rubrics_metrics.name: OMB/DPC report to the President on implementation across the executive branch
rubrics_metrics.description: OMB, in coordination with the DPC, submit to the President, within 1 year of November 5, 2009, a report on the implementation of EO 13175 across the executive branch based on its review of agency reports, as well as recommendations, if any, for improving tribal participation in Federal policy decisions affecting Indian tribes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The report must be submitted within the specified 1-year timeframe and should synthesize agency plans and progress reports, assess implementation across agencies, and include recommendations to improve tribal participation in federal policy decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Implement EO 13175 consultation and coordination requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: The Presidential Memorandum directs executive departments and agencies to take certain actions to implement Executive Order 13175, which addresses the Federal Government’s consultation and coordination with Indian tribal governments.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Agency plans and reports should demonstrate how agency actions fulfill the consultation and coordination obligations set out in EO 13175; this is the overarching compliance standard that the other requirements support.
